pharaoh.note: Free spins re-use the triggering bet and cannot re-trigger. A free spin that shows 15 Pharaohs pays 5 x 1000 x bet.

atlantis.note: There is NO win cap in the code. These are mathematical ceilings (every cascade a perfect 210x board, 100 cascades, multiplier at cap); the real probability of anything near them is effectively zero. The largest payout actually observed is in the simulation result.
